images.prompt: A gothic archive mausoleum — a small stone building with the look of a crypt crossed with an ancient library. Heavy stone walls with carved nerve-cell and circuit motifs. Iron-grated windows glow faintly green from within. Stacked stone filing drawers line the visible interior. A heavy padlocked door has a brass plate reading 'ARCHIVES'. Cobwebs, moss, and aged brass fittings everywhere. Feels like the knowledge is still alive but entombed. Whimsical board-game piece style, transparent background.
